messages:
sophie_pm: Huge win — Asteria Logistics is live as an ISV partner! They published our "Redwood Connector for Asteria TMS" in Azure Marketplace and signed a 12-month Dedicated commitment for EU region. :tada:

matt_sales: Incredible. Committed ARR looks like $216k annually (~$18k/month). Who owns the case study and customer quote?

diego_partnerships: I'll lead the case study. @sophie_pm can you drop the customer quote and high-level outcomes + their logo files?

anjali_eng: Onboarding plan: private control plane + VPC peering. Need their infra contacts and expected throughput numbers. @kevin_ops can we open a Dedicated onboarding runbook?

kevin_ops: Yes — booking onboarding slot Tue 10:00 UTC. ops-bot, please create ticket and calendar invite.

ops-bot: Ticket RDW-3245 created: "Asteria Dedicated Onboarding - EU". Invite sent to asteria_onboarding@asterialogistics.com

legal_bot: NDA completed; commercial SOW countersigned and uploaded to /contracts/Asteria_2026_SOW.pdf

sophie_pm: Heads up — Asteria wants a co-branded case study + short press blurb in ~3 weeks. Marketing + comms needed. Also they requested support for a pilot with model pinning to our Llama-3-Chat-70B variant.

matt_sales: :clap: Marketing — @jules_marketing any bandwidth for a 1-pager and logo approval flow? Also need to record the opportunity in SFDC.

jules_marketing: Yep, can draft. Send 2–3 customer bullets: latency, throughput, cost delta, and a quote. I can draft by EOD Fri for approvals.

anjali_eng: Infra notes: recommend quantization profile `q4f16` with autoscale baseline 6 GPUs for EU-1, canary rollout with 10% traffic first hour. I'll prep the runbook and perf numbers.

sophie_pm: Early metrics to highlight (subject to infra verification): ~45% gen latency reduction vs their previous provider, ~3x throughput increase on peak, ~22% per-token cost reduction. Diego can you confirm these with them?

diego_partnerships: On it. Asteria's CPO and platform lead are OK with sharing metrics — will request sign-off on the quote and an internal hero customer name.

matt_sales: Assigning renewal owner: @sophie_pm. SFDC opp: AST-2026-01. Sales team — add notes about co-sell motion in EU marketplace.

kevin_ops: Quick onboarding checklist snippet:
```
- VPC peering & routing
- KMS/HSM key exchange
- Model pinning & config
- Canary rollout + SLA verification
- Load testing and perf tuning
```
Ping me for the infra runbook link.

sophie_pm: Thanks all. Diego — can you secure a short customer quote by Wednesday so marketing can begin? Also need logo in SVG and PNG.

diego_partnerships: Will loop in Asteria CPO (cpo@asterialogistics.com) now. Expect reply in 24–48h.

matt_sales: Woot! :rocket:

jules_marketing: I'll set up a shared doc for approvals and add the draft timeline.

sophie_pm: Love it. Final ask: legal, please confirm any brand guidelines or quote redline risks ASAP.

legal_bot: No brand restrictions in the SOW, standard logo use approved. Anything else, ping me.

matt_sales: Celebratory GIF incoming in #random :smile:

sophie_pm: Closing — thanks team. Recording this thread as the canonical kickoff. We'll sync on Tue onboarding call.
